answer.book: Pars Secunda of J. H. Heidegger's Concilii Tridentini anatome historico-theologica (Tigurum, 1672): commentary on Trent's Sessions XXI–XXV, each with its Decreta, Historia, Notae and Quaestiones, followed by the Bulla Pii IV with its Historia and Notae, the Index IV (Locorum Scripturae) and Index V (Rerum & Personarum); Jacobi Augusti Thuani Historia Concilii Tridentini is appended as a second work.
